suites.description: Node tests for scripts/ci-front-door*.cjs, scripts/go-unit-suite*.cjs and the CGO selection, unit partition and researcher workflow contracts.
Compile every Go package and integration-tagged test binary with go test -run='^$' -exec=true -tags=integration ./...; executes no tests.

Required fast Go unit tests with coverage across 12 test-name shards. Excludes only the measured >=10s tests listed in .github/ci/go-unit-slow-tests.json, keeping unmeasured tests by default. Requires verify-integration-build.

Measured >=10s Go unit tests from .github/ci/go-unit-slow-tests.json in four shards: repository workflow lint/compile sweeps, Azure bundled-Node connectors, workflow reader/checkout/npm runtime parity, and CLI/parser/workqueue closure tests. Top observed tests: repository lint 130.67s, repository compile 57.81s, reserved-closure workqueue 50.39s. Requires verify-integration-build; select independently of fast test. New suite runner duration is not yet measured.

Check full Go unit-test coverage using combined artifacts from test and test-slow; compare discovered test names with executed tests. Requires both unit suites and their integration compilation prerequisite.
Run make test-impacted-go BASE_REF=HEAD^ to select and execute impacted Go tests from source and test changes.
Go native JavaScript security/taint-analysis regression tests and equivalence checks against official GitHub Actions expression and workflow parsers.
Build the native CLI with make build and regenerate workflow locks using npm dependencies and the Go compiler. Upload the Linux binary for consumers.
Build cmd/gh-aw-wasm and execute Go and Node.js compiler WASM golden tests, including browser-compatible Go packages and compiler fixtures.
Validate workflow YAML escape sequences and release compilation, skill URLs, and .github/aw/releases.json and compat.json against their schemas.
Run the validator source file-size checker; report oversized validation Go files.
Check formatting of Go source and test files with repository Go formatting commands.
Run golangci-lint on Go packages in three shards, including compiler, CLI, internal tools, test files, and lint configuration.
Run govulncheck for vulnerable Go dependencies and reachable vulnerable functions in the Go application.
Run custom Go linters for native and WASM builds, console stderr checks, unchecked printf diagnostics, and action shell script linting.
Lint Go error messages against repository formatting and style requirements.
Build and validate the bundled GitHub Actions via internal/tools/actions-build and their JavaScript/shell runtime inputs.
Compile integration-tagged Go tests and run grouped parser/workflow fuzz tests covering schedules, triggers, expressions, injection, sanitization, and YAML.
Run Go security regression tests for compiler/runtime security behavior. Requires the native CLI build job.
Run zizmor, actionlint, poutine, and runner-guard through the built CLI on the poem workflow. Requires the build job's uploaded Linux binary.
Build the native CLI and test the MCP server compile tool against a deliberately invalid workflow.
Build and test the native CLI on BOTH macOS and Windows, compile sample workflows, check generated shell syntax and scan the Windows binary. Requires build.
Build the Linux CLI, construct an Alpine Docker image, and compile a workflow inside it to verify container compatibility.
Run scripts/check-safe-outputs-conformance.sh to check safe-output specifications, schemas, Go configuration, and JavaScript handlers for consistency.
